notablePrerequisites: Aether Vial has exactly three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Pestermite onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Deceiver Exarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Aether Vial by tapping it, putting Deceiver Exarch onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Aether Vial.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Pestermite from the battlefield to your hand.
